spec: ACT2_COVER_STORY v0.1.1 (design repo, private; D1680-D1699): the slices that play in Act 2's opening. Mom's 'Supper' (C-M, §2.3) after the posting, with her repeats, the daily snack (D1696) and the pin variant for a save that never wore the lanyard (§5.2, D1695); and Juniper's optional reveal point in Fernbrook (§3.4, D1688).
_about: Ours, not a design copy. Applied after detail_zzz_act2_opener.json. The reveal system keys on a lanyard past: story.cover=glimmer | seal:seal_glim_1 (D1695). Same three choices everywhere (D1681). Save stays pixelpets.save.v2, v 2; new additive story.* keys only; nothing written at load. Not built here (their beats are not built): Lizzy's scene (C-L, after B9), Rook (B5), Lumen (B7), Fen (B8), the copy in R4 (B11), the barks and gossip.

addObjs.name: Mom
addObjs._note: §2.3 m3: Mom at your door. Talking to her first plays the same scene from the drawer.

cv_mom_gate: There you are. Ilse kept you long enough. Walk me home before your coach?
A Keeper pin. Look at you. Sit down before supper goes cold.
cv_mom_home: A Keeper pin. Look at you. Sit down before supper goes cold.
cv_mom_supper: You put the company lanyards in the drawer. Not on your coat, Ilse said.
Is that a Glimmerwell lanyard? Three of them?
Hattie showed me a Ribbit post. You, on the Brinewick quay, in their colours.
Now there's a Keeper pin on your coat, and the Governor has sent for you.
I'm not cross, love. I'm lost. Who are you working for?
You tell her. Ilse asked you to wear it, to watch, and to tell only her.
Oh, love. So that's why you came home so tired.
I won't breathe a word. Maze, you didn't hear that.
Come home when you can. There'll always be something packed for {pet}.
Mom packs a snack for {pet} daily.
You tell her the Keepers made you a better offer. It sounds true out loud.
Hm. A better offer. They always sound good at the door.
Just keep coming home between them.
You don't answer. Mom looks at the drawer, then at you.
All right. When you're ready. The kettle stays warm.
She takes her coat on the way down. You hear the door.
cv_juniper: {name}! You vanished from the partnership! Did the Keepers poach you? Blink twice!
Undercover? But I gave you that lanyard. I meant it. I meant all of it.
I'm going to ask Imogen if that's allowed. It isn't, is it?
By evening her lantern stand is gone from the plaza.
Aw. No hard feelings! The trial lanyard offer stays open. Have a bright day!
Mysterious! Very Keeper of you. Have a bright day!

objPatch._note: Mom's Act 2 repeats and the daily snack go before her plain line (her Act 1 keys still win); the drawer in your room plays Supper while it waits; downstairs Mom steps out while she is upstairs at your door. Juniper's point comes first on her Fernbrook body in Act 2 for a lanyard past; truth sends her and her stand off the plaza.

add.story.cv_mom=told: I told nobody. Well. Maze. She's a vault.
add.story.cv_mom=cover: A better offer. Hattie isn't buying it.
add.story.cv_mom=quiet: Ilse says you're hers. That'll do me.
